summary.text: Luan Baci is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Baci was the Democratic candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 38, in 2024 and lost in the general election.
